rules: Every supported capability action must be classified by trusted registration as read-only or mutating; unclassified registration fails closed.
Mutation status is derived from the selected RegisteredCapability, never from ExecutionRequest.side_effect_class.
Every trusted mutating action must declare target_authority on the request and pass authority admission.
Every mutating capability action must have a trusted capability registration contract that classifies it as EPHEMERAL or DURABLE_OR_EXTERNAL; absence of a trusted contract fails closed.
EPHEMERAL mutation does not fabricate a persistent asset and cannot carry persistent CRUD/asset assertions.

DURABLE_OR_EXTERNAL mutation derives CRUD semantics from the selected capability registration, canonicalizes the target through the selected adapter, and resolves lifecycle/owner/role/permissions from the trusted PersistentAssetCatalog.
Request-provided side-effect, persistence, CRUD or asset metadata cannot override trusted capability or catalog semantics.

Trusted CRUD must match the executor's real effect; actions whose real effect differs between CREATE and UPDATE must expose distinct trusted action contracts or equivalent trusted pre-execution derivation.
ActionCoordinator or the host-equivalent decision layer must be bound to the selected authority_context.
Same-authority mutation is permitted subject to owner rules, trusted mutation/asset admission, normal action/approval/concurrency controls and the applicable repository/workspace workflow.
A registered ancestor may mutate a descendant only when the hierarchy is known and the request carries a non-empty governance_basis.

UAOS parent-governed descendant changes must read current domain binding/business authority, perform impact analysis and preserve domain-specific validation; governance_basis is lineage, not a bypass.
DOMAIN:X -> UAOS direct authoritative mutation is prohibited.
DOMAIN:X -> DOMAIN:Y direct authoritative mutation is prohibited.

Reconciliation must bind the immutable original request, the original admission receipt and the original capability registration generation, then rerun authority/persistent/approval gates before adapter reconciliation.
Executor and reconciler dispositions must be normalized to the trusted disposition enum before migration, fallback, routing or terminal-state decisions.
Approval cannot override hierarchy, trusted asset ownership/lifecycle, trusted capability action/CRUD semantics, or owner-specific mutation restrictions.

always_on_mutation_sentinel.compatibility_note: Legacy target/role/lifecycle/owner check identifiers are retained, but their values now come from trusted capability registration, adapter canonicalization and catalog resolution rather than request labels.

required_properties: candidate isolation for material architecture/governance changes
problem-response research and reflection per current deliberation policy
trusted complete action mutability classification before execution
trusted capability mutation classification and canonical target resolution before durable/external mutation
trusted persistent asset catalog admission for durable/external mutation
freshness/concurrency protection appropriate to the write path
production authority reread and post-promotion observation
user-visible report of changes and evidence

required_evidence: active protection on the relevant production ref
required owner-appropriate status checks when part of the claim
no writer bypass inconsistent with the claimed guarantee
